title: ai-rulez worktree provision
description: Output of `ai-rulez worktree create|setup --format json`: what the run carried into the destination worktree and whether generation ran. Paths are relative to the source and destination checkouts; no file content is reported.

source.description: Absolute path of the source checkout the run provisioned from.

destination.description: Absolute path of the linked worktree the run provisioned.

dry_run.description: True when the run planned and wrote nothing.

copies.description: The machine-local files carried (or planned, in a dry run), sorted by destination-relative path.

source.description: Path relative to the source checkout.

destination.description: Path relative to the destination worktree.

action.description: copy wrote the file; identical left the destination's same bytes alone.

generated.description: True when the destination's outputs were regenerated (always false for a dry run).

plan.description: The generate step's lines: its plan in a dry run, its output in a real run.

conflicts.description: Present when the run refused: destination files that differ from what the source would carry. Nothing was written.
